question: How many seats are reserved for scheduled castes in Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**84.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• For the purpose of constituting the Lok Sabha, the whole country has been divided into** 543 Parliamentary Constituencies.**
 
• Each one of which elects one member.
 
• Some seats are reserved in Lok Sabha for the members of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
